title: Social post creation with link previews
name: Post link previews

locateQuestion.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code sanitizes user-supplied input before it is stored and rendered? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
locateQuestion.explanation: Yes. Links are filtered with a denylist of two schemes matched at the very start of the raw string. Anything else that contains a colon is stored as-is: data:text/html,..., a leading space or tab before javascript: (browsers strip leading whitespace in href), or a scheme split by an embedded tab or newline like java\tscript:. The renderer HTML-escapes the attribute, but escaping does not neutralise a dangerous URL scheme, so clicking the link runs script. Links should be parsed with URL and accepted only if the protocol is on an allowlist (http:/https:).

choiceQuestions.prompt: A user submits the link "example.com/path". What is stored?
choices: It is rejected because it has no scheme
choiceQuestions.explanation: The raw value has no colon, so https:// is prepended; new URL parses it and the hostname example.com becomes the label. It is not rejected, the href is rewritten rather than kept raw, and the code uses https, not http.

choiceQuestions.prompt: A post body contains . What happens?
choices: The tag is stripped before the body is stored
The body is stored as written and rendered as inert text because esc runs at render time
The image tag executes when the card renders
choiceQuestions.explanation: PostService only trims, NFC-normalises and length-checks the body; it stores the original text. renderPostCard passes it through esc, so < and > become entities and nothing executes. There is no rejection and no stripping at write time.

choiceQuestions.prompt: A request has 5 links where the first is invalid. What is the result?
choices: ValidationError about the link count, before any link is checked
ValidationError saying a link is not allowed
The post is stored with the 4 valid links
The post is stored with no links
choiceQuestions.explanation: The MAX_LINKS check runs before the loop over links, so 5 links fail immediately with 'at most 4 links per post'. The per-link check is never reached, and nothing is stored, because validation throws before repo.insert.
